EFS/S28.detail: Re-checked after review 2026-10-14 (18:00 JST runs: fix-*.json). (a) device clock 2 h behind, both contexts: the tail, appended in one input event after the session ended, reached the device copy ('QA-EFS-28 first line. QA-EFS-28 behind tail.', savedAt 2 h before the server-stamped encounterEditedAt) and was NOT restored: the box shows only 'QA-EFS-28 first line.'. (b) device clock 2 h ahead, both contexts: the device copy held the stale tail; the other (normally clocked) session's newer text was read back from the server ('QA-EFS-28 newer text from the computer.'), then after the phone signed in the server and the box hold the phone's old copy ('QA-EFS-28 first line. QA-EFS-28 ahead stale tail.'). (c) unchanged since 16:32: device copies 19 h / 37 h (Hospital) and 13 h (NH) old are put silently into today's Encounter box with no date; draft rows gone after load (restored, not expired) — same root cause as TC-25/S27 R, see productIssue part 2.
EFS/S28.productIssue: 1) [draft-restore-device-clock] Mixed-clock case only: whether a kept device copy is restored is decided by the copy's savedAt (device clock) against the field's *EditedAt, and that stamp can come from another clock: server time (Quick Dictation, convex/quickDictation.ts:154) or another, correctly clocked device (client Date.now()). (a) Phone 2 h slow, field last stamped by the server: the words dictated after the session expired are dropped without notice — after signing in the Encounter box shows only 'QA-EFS-28 first line.' (both contexts; the device copy held the tail). (b) Phone 2 h fast: the server held the computer's newer text 'QA-EFS-28 newer text from the computer.'; after the phone signed in again, its old copy replaced it on the server and on screen (both contexts). A phone that is the only editor stamps device time on both sides and is not affected. Breaks EFS U10a/U13 ('nothing typed is lost', the tail comes back) and ground rule 3.8 (time-based state uses server time).  2) (c) is the same issue as TC-25/S27 R: [kept-draft-restore-after-sweep] Text the retention sweep cleared comes back from a device copy. What a physician sees: yesterday's pre-round text (past its 12 h window) or encounter text (past 36 h) reappears, undated, in today's field on the phone, is saved again (stamped now) and shows on the computer; in Hospital the encounter the sweep had already archived ('Oct 12 · Encounter notes') is re-saved as today's encounter as well. How such a copy is left behind in normal use: a device copy left behind after a normal save — e.g. leaving the field within the 0.8 s autosave (the unmount flush writes the copy and saves; nothing deletes the copy once the server has the same text: TC-25/S27 L-leftover, both contexts), or a Save Note that changes the stored text (TC-25/S17 b-hospital end-of-run row). Cause: the sweep clears preRoundNotes / encounterNotes (convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:124, :163 Hospital; :306, :329 Nursing Home) without moving *EditedAt, and useAutosave restores any device copy whose savedAt is newer than that stamp, however old (src/lib/useAutosave.ts:115-137; the copy's own age is never checked). Breaks UAT 3.6 (retention windows) and OAT-04 ('never survives past its window'); EFS U13 / S28 (c) (old text not silently put into today's field).
